obligations.ask: Attend the council tax account appointment

results.segment: This letter confirms your appointment about your council tax account with Kelsford Borough Council on 22 May 2026 at 10.40am.
Please arrive ten minutes early and bring this letter with you.
If you can no longer attend, our reception team will be glad to offer the time to somebody else.
We expect to write to you again in about 6 weeks with the annual summary.
